# Matching Design and Coefficient Test Function

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Caliper Matching
# ============================================================

matching_variables <- c(
  "regime_type_int",
  "regime_type_difference",
  "coldwar",
  "relative_power",
  "contiguous_intervener",
  "milint",
  "contiguous_actors",
  "protrac",
  "gravcr"
)

data_complete <- synthesized_data[
  complete.cases(synthesized_data[, matching_variables]),
]


m.caliper <- MatchIt::matchit(
  regime_type_int ~ regime_type_difference + coldwar +
    relative_power + contiguous_intervener + milint +
    contiguous_actors + protrac + gravcr,
  data = data_complete,
  method = "nearest",
  distance = "glm",
  caliper = 0.2,
  ratio = 1,
  replace = FALSE
)

matched_caliper <- MatchIt::match.data(m.caliper)


# ============================================================
# Clustered HC3 test function
# ============================================================

cluster_test <- function(model) {
  lmtest::coeftest(
    model,
    vcov. = sandwich::vcovCL(
      model,
      cluster = ~ crisno,
      type = "HC3"
    )
  )
}
```

# Main Results

## Long-term Models

```{r}
# ============================================================
# H1.1: Regime type
# ============================================================

h1.1_without_US <- glm(
  outesr ~ regime_type_int +
    regime_type_difference +
    coldwar +
    relative_power +
    contiguous_intervener +
    milint +
    contiguous_actors +
    protrac +
    gravcr,
  data = matched_caliper,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  weights = weights
)

cluster_test(h1.1_without_US)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Export models for ICB-Plots.Rmd
# ============================================================

dir.create(here("models"), showWarnings = FALSE)

model_names <- ls(
  pattern = "^h[12]\\.[0-9]+_(without|with)_US$"
)

print(model_names)
cat("\nNumber of models:", length(model_names), "\n")

stopifnot(length(model_names) == 48)

save(
  list = c(model_names, "matched_caliper"),
  file = here("models", "ICB_models.RData")
)

```
